description: This Kotlin source file defines the `PlaybackService` class for an Android app. The service manages two instances of the ExoPlayer for audio playback, handles mixing controls like crossfade, tempo adjustments, and effects such as echo and reverb. It also manages notifications and media control interfaces, facilitating playback of audio media with user-adjustable parameters.

classes.name: PlaybackService
classes.description: The main Android service class responsible for managing two media players for DJ-style playback, including controls for playback, effects, and saving mixes.

classes.name: LocalBinder
classes.description: Inner class for binding the service to clients, providing access to the PlaybackService instance.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes media players, sets up notification channel, and starts foreground service.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Provides the binder for clients to connect to the service.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Releases media resources when the service is destroyed.

methods.name: loadDeckA
methods.description: Loads an audio URI into Player A.

methods.name: loadDeckB
methods.description: Loads an audio URI into Player B.

methods.name: setCrossfade
methods.description: Sets the volume balance between Player A and Player B.

methods.name: setTempoA
methods.description: Adjusts playback speed of Player A.

methods.name: setTempoB
methods.description: Adjusts playback speed of Player B.

methods.name: setFilter
methods.description: Sets the filter cutoff frequency (placeholder for future DSP).

methods.name: saveCurrentMix
methods.description: Saves current settings and media state to a file.
